name: ezil-os-shell
_comment_type: Deliberately NOT "type": "module". Setting it makes esbuild treat every vendored UMD lib under src/lib as ESM, so jQuery and isMobile stop exporting a default and build-shell.sh FAILS. load-test.mjs is .mjs and is ESM without it.
description: Build + smoke-test harness for the EZiL-OS browser shell. Not a published package, and not a dependency of app/ or worker/ - it exists so load-test.mjs has somewhere to declare jsdom.
